Because you enjoy it you want to win and it satisfies you intellectually, or are you trading to get rich? This is a complex question, given the instant feedback and direct monetary rewards of successful Trading. Research shows that if you dream of being rich, no matter how rich you get, you'll always wish you were richer. So pursuing money for the sake of money is a pointless goal. There's a concept known as the hedonic treadmill which states that as human beings earn more money their desires and expectations rise in tandem so that no amount of wealth will lead to Greater happiness. Research shows this to be generally true. Once someone makes enough money to comfortably acquire shelter, clothing, Food, and Health Care, which is an annual income somewhere around. 75 K to 1255 per year. In most parts of the United States. Additional increases in income do not increase happiness, very much. Harvard study of adult development, followed the lives of hundreds of people over 8 decades and found the happiest people were the ones that had the strongest and most durable relationships with Community, family, and friends. Relationships predict, longevity, and happiness. Better than money intelligence. Or fame.
